verses.en: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
verses.pt: E eis que um homem de Deus por palavra do SENHOR veio de Judá a Betel; e estando Jeroboão ao altar para queimar incenso,
verses.en_web: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by Yahweh’s word to Beth El; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.
verses.en_bbe: Then a man of God came from Judah by the order of the Lord to Beth-el, where Jeroboam was by the altar, burning offerings.

verses.en: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon thee.
verses.pt: Ele clamou contra o altar por palavra do SENHOR, e disse: Altar, altar, assim disse o SENHOR: Eis que à casa de Davi nascerá um filho, chamado Josias, o qual sacrificará sobre ti aos sacerdotes dos altos que queimam sobre ti incenso; e sobre ti queimarão ossos humanos.
verses.en_web: He cried against the altar by Yahweh’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! Yahweh says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”
verses.en_bbe: And by the order of the Lord he made an outcry against the altar, saying, O altar, altar, the Lord has said, From the seed of David will come a child, named Josiah, and on you he will put to death the priests of the high places, who are burning offerings on you, and men's bones will be burned on you.

verses.en: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.
verses.pt: E aquele mesmo dia deu um sinal, dizendo: Esta é o sinal de que o SENHOR falou: eis que que o altar se quebrará, e a cinza que sobre ele está se derramará.
verses.en_web: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which Yahweh has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”
verses.en_bbe: The same day he gave them a sign, saying, This is the sign which the Lord has given: See, the altar will be broken and the burned waste on it overturned.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
verses.pt: E quando o rei Jeroboão ouviu a palavra do homem de Deus, que havia clamado contra o altar de Betel, estendendo sua mão desde o altar, disse: Prendei-lhe! Mas a mão que havia estendido contra ele, se lhe secou, que não a pôde voltar a si.
verses.en_web: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.
verses.en_bbe: Then the king, hearing the man of God crying out against the altar at Beth-el, put out his hand from the altar, saying, Take him prisoner. And his hand, stretched out against him, became dead, and he had no power of pulling it back.

verses.en: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.
verses.pt: E o altar se rompeu, e derramou-se a cinza do altar, conforme o sinal que o homem de Deus havia dado por palavra do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by Yahweh’s word.
verses.en_bbe: And the altar was broken and the burned waste on it overturned; this was the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the Lord.

verses.en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.
verses.pt: Então respondendo o rei, disse ao homem de Deus: Peço-te que rogues à face do SENHOR teu Deus, e ora por mim, que minha mão me seja restituída. E o homem de Deus orou à face do SENHOR, e a mão do rei se lhe recuperou e tornou-se como antes.
verses.en_web: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of Yahweh your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again.” The man of God interceded with Yahweh, and the king’s hand was restored to him again, and became as it was before.
verses.en_bbe: Then the king made answer and said to the man of God, Make a prayer now for the grace of the Lord your God, and for me, that my hand may be made well. And in answer to the prayer of the man of God, the king's hand was made well again, as it was before.

verses.en: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.
verses.pt: E o rei disse ao homem de Deus: Vem comigo à casa, e comerás, e eu te darei um presente.
verses.en_web: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me, and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”
verses.en_bbe: And the king said to the man of God, Come with me to my house for food and rest, and I will give you a reward.

verses.en: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
verses.pt: Mas o homem de Deus disse ao rei: Se me desses a metade de tua casa, não iria contigo, nem comeria pão nem beberia água neste lugar;
verses.en_web: The man of God said to the king, “Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;
verses.en_bbe: But the man of God said to the king, Even if you gave me half of all you have, I would not go in with you, and I would not take food or a drink of water in this place;

verses.en: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.
verses.pt: Porque assim me está mandado por palavra do SENHOR, dizendo: Não comas pão, nem bebas água, nem voltes pelo caminho que fordes.
verses.en_web: for so was it commanded me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”
verses.en_bbe: For so I was ordered by the word of the Lord, who said, You are not to take food or a drink of water, and you are not to go back the way you came.

verses.en: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.
verses.pt: Foi-se, pois, por outro caminho, e não voltou pelo caminho por de onde havia vindo a Betel.
verses.en_web: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.
verses.en_bbe: So he went another way, and not by the way he came to Beth-el.

verses.en: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
verses.pt: Morava naquele tempo em Betel um velho profeta, ao qual veio seu filho, e contou-lhe tudo o que o homem de Deus havia feito aquele dia em Betel: contaram-lhe também a seu pai as palavras que havia falado ao rei.
verses.en_web: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.
verses.en_bbe: Now there was an old prophet living in Beth-el; and one of his sons came and gave him word of all the man of God had done that day in Beth-el, and they gave their father an account of the words he had said to the king.

verses.en: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.
verses.pt: E seu pai lhes disse: Por que caminho foi? E seus filhos lhe mostraram o caminho por de onde se havia voltado o homem de Deus, que havia vindo de Judá.
verses.en_web: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.
verses.en_bbe: Then their father said to them, Which way did he go? Now his sons had seen which way the man of God who came from Judah had gone.

verses.en: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
verses.pt: E ele disse a seus filhos: Preparai-me o asno. E eles lhe prepararam o asno, e subiu nele.
verses.en_web: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.
verses.en_bbe: So the prophet said to his sons, Make ready an ass for me. So they made an ass ready, and he got on it,

verses.en: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.
verses.pt: E indo atrás o homem de Deus, achou-lhe que estava sentado debaixo de um carvalho: e disse-lhe: És tu o homem de Deus que vieste de Judá? E ele disse: Eu sou.
verses.en_web: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He said, “I am.”
verses.en_bbe: And went after the man of God, and came up with him while he was seated under an oak-tree. And he said to him, Are you the man of God who came from Judah? And he said, I am.

verses.en: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe então: Vem comigo à casa, e come do pão.
verses.en_web: Then he said to him, “Come home with me, and eat bread.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to him, Come back to the house with me and have a meal.

verses.en: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
verses.pt: Mas ele respondeu: Não poderei voltar contigo, nem irei contigo; nem tampouco comerei pão nem beberei água contigo neste lugar;
verses.en_web: He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
verses.en_bbe: But he said, I may not go back with you or go into your house; and I will not take food or a drink of water with you in this place;

verses.en: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
verses.pt: Porque por palavra de Deus me foi dito: Não comas pão nem bebas água ali, nem voltes pelo caminho que fores.
verses.en_web: For it was said to me by Yahweh’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord said to me, You are not to take food or water there, or go back again by the way you came.

verses.en: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
verses.pt: E o outro lhe disse: Eu também sou profeta como tu, e um anjo me falou pela palavra do SENHOR, dizendo: Faze-o voltar contigo à tua casa, para que coma pão e beba água. Porém mentiu-lhe.
verses.en_web: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to him, I am a prophet like you; and an angel said to me by the word of the Lord, Take him back with you and give him food and water. But he said false words to him.

verses.en: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.pt: Então voltou com ele, e comeu do pão em sua casa, e bebeu da água.
verses.en_web: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.en_bbe: So he went back with him, and had a meal in his house and a drink of water.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, estando eles à mesa, veio a palavra do SENHOR ao profeta que lhe havia feito voltar;
verses.en_web: As they sat at the table, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;
verses.en_bbe: But while they were seated at the table, the word of the Lord came to the prophet who had taken him back;

verses.en: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,
verses.pt: E clamou ao homem de Deus que havia vindo de Judá, dizendo: Assim disse o SENHOR: Porquanto foste rebelde ao dito do SENHOR, e não guardaste o mandamento que o SENHOR teu Deus te havia prescrito,
verses.en_web: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to Yahweh’s mouth, and have not kept the commandment which Yahweh your God commanded you,
verses.en_bbe: And crying out to the man of God who came from Judah, he said, The Lord says, Because you have gone against the voice of the Lord, and have not done as you were ordered by the Lord,

verses.en: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the LORD did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
verses.pt: Em vez disso voltaste, e comeste do pão e bebeste da água no lugar de onde o SENHOR te havia dito não comesses pão nem bebesses água, não entrará teu corpo no sepulcro de teus pais.
verses.en_web: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water”; your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”
verses.en_bbe: But have come back, and have taken food and water in this place where he said you were to take no food or water; your dead body will not be put to rest with your fathers.

verses.en: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.pt: E quando havia comido do pão e bebido, o profeta que lhe havia feito voltar lhe preparou um asno;
verses.en_web: After he had eaten bread, and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.en_bbe: Now after the meal he made ready the ass for him, for the prophet whom he had taken back.

verses.en: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
verses.pt: E indo-se, encontrou-lhe um leão no caminho, e matou-lhe; e seu corpo estava lançado no caminho, e o asno estava junto a ele, e o leão também estava junto ao corpo.
verses.en_web: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.
verses.en_bbe: And he went on his way; but on the road a lion came rushing at him and put him to death; and his dead body was stretched in the road with the ass by its side, and the lion was there by the body.

verses.en: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
verses.pt: E eis que uns que passavam, e viram o corpo que estava lançado no caminho, e o leão que estava junto ao corpo: e vieram, e disseram-no na cidade de onde o velho profeta habitava.
verses.en_web: Behold, men passed by, and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.
verses.en_bbe: And some men, going by, saw the body stretched out in the road with the lion by its side; and they came and gave news of it in the town where the old prophet was living.

verses.en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.
verses.pt: E ouvindo-o o profeta que lhe havia voltado do caminho, disse: O homem de Deus é, que foi rebelde ao dito do SENHOR: portanto o SENHOR lhe entregou ao leão, que lhe quebrantou e matou, conforme à palavra do SENHOR que ele lhe disse.
verses.en_web: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to Yahweh’s mouth. Therefore Yahweh has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke to him.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the prophet who had made him come back, hearing it, said, It is the man of God, who went against the word of the Lord; that is why the Lord has given him to the lion to be wounded to death, as the Lord said.

verses.en: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
verses.pt: E falou a seus filhos, e disse-lhes: Preparai-me um asno. E eles se o prepararam.
verses.en_web: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to his sons, Make ready the ass for me. And they did so.

verses.en: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
verses.pt: E ele foi, e achou seu corpo estendido no caminho, e o asno e o leão estavam junto ao corpo: o leão não havia comido o corpo, nem danificado ao asno.
verses.en_web: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body, nor mauled the donkey.
verses.en_bbe: And he went and saw the dead body stretched out in the road with the ass and the lion by its side: the lion had not taken the body for its food or done any damage to the ass.

verses.en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
verses.pt: E tomando o profeta o corpo do homem de Deus, o pôs sobre o asno, e o levou. E o profeta velho veio à cidade, para lamentar-lhe e enterrar-lhe.
verses.en_web: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.
verses.en_bbe: Then the prophet took up the body of the man of God and put it on the ass and took it back; and he came to the town to put the body to rest with weeping.

verses.en: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!
verses.pt: E pôs seu corpo em seu sepulcro; e lamentaram-lhe, dizendo: Ai, irmão meu!
verses.en_web: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”
verses.en_bbe: And he put the body in the resting-place made ready for himself, weeping and sorrowing over it, saying, O my brother!

verses.en: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
verses.pt: E depois que lhe houveram enterrado, falou a seus filhos, dizendo: Quando eu morrer, enterrai-me no sepulcro em que está sepultado o homem de Deus; ponde meus ossos junto aos seus.
verses.en_web: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had put it to rest, he said to his sons, When I am dead, then you are to put my body into the earth with the body of this man of God, and put me by his bones so that my bones may be kept safe with his bones.

verses.en: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
verses.pt: Porque sem dúvida virá o que ele disse a vozes por palavra do SENHOR contra o altar que está em Betel, e contra todas as casas dos altos que estão nas cidades de Samaria.
verses.en_web: For the saying which he cried by Yahweh’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”
verses.en_bbe: For the outcry he made by the word of the Lord against the altar in Beth-el and against all the houses of the high places in the towns of Samaria, will certainly come about.

verses.en: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
verses.pt: Depois disto não se converteu Jeroboão de seu mau caminho: antes voltou a fazer sacerdotes dos altos da classe do povo, e quem queria se consagrava, e era dos sacerdotes dos altos.
verses.en_web: After this thing Jeroboam didn’t return from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.
verses.en_bbe: After this Jeroboam, not turning back from his evil ways, still made priests for his altars from among all the people; he made a priest of anyone desiring it, so that there might be priests of the high places.

verses.en: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
verses.pt: E isto foi causa de pecado à casa de Jeroboão; pelo qual foi cortada e desraigada de sobre a face da terra.
verses.en_web: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And this became a sin in the family of Jeroboam, causing it to be cut off and sent to destruction from the face of the earth.
